scope: A separate frozen saved-endpoint actual-force audit,not an integrator,production Run,PART restart,public GPU gravity or physical admission. Source numerical results were not read to select budgets or nonempty requirements.

No nested include of the new gravity solver CPP,whose inner undef would destroy an outer main rename. Its old solver/reader main is never called. Existing project headers and CPU Wendland kernel header only;no new CNG/bcrypt dependency.

Constant law or manufactured smooth k=k0 exp((J-1)/((1-n0)Ck)),Ck2^-13;gamma=rhow*9.80665 independent of body-gravity magnitude. No wall/load/drain/plastic/HG/SPR/shift/viscosity admission.
public_and_initialization: All three public XML keys stay explicitly0. Constructor sets only Observer/Feedback/DynamicPressure and optional private conductivity/Ck. One fresh independent object follows the successful wall-audit lifecycle:select device,timers,LoadConfig,LoadCaseParticles,VisuConfig,ConfigDomain,ConfigRunMode,InitRunGpu,FreePartsInit. native_input: Directly load original15 typed arrays plus actual double J/n/theta. Actual positions/stored stress are double;pressure,p0,excess,passive density,display stress and plasticity retain native float types. Verify six display stress components round stored double state,private metadata absent from both global and PART scopes,and V/rho/k/PosDiv absent. Saved n is actual native;common V/rho/k are explicitly derived,not native outputs. Require unchanged initial sine/J1/p0/stress0 and the original weak saturated/elastic/load/passive-rho domain.
import_and_ownership: Map actual downloaded Idp/Code to unique normal fluid owners0..511. Pass only512 contiguous NORMAL positions/codes to actual LoadDcellParticles,scatter saved fields/Dcell to native slots,then actual RunCellDivide(true) retires stale periodic images and creates/sorts fresh copies. Never include primary-domain-exterior old images in the host native Dcell check or manually assign Np. After each actual force,require every actual periodic slot's J,C,Ace,theta and rate byte-identical to its normal-fluid same-ID owner. This independently reconstructs the owner relation from actual GPU arrays;it does not claim to download the already-consumed production ridp scratch or observe original integrator owners.
frozen_clock: Assign source TimeStep/Nstep solely as exact labels on the separate audit object. LastDt=0 initial or declared dt later is bookkeeping,not a value recovered from BI4. SymplecticDtPre is explicitly the declared locked dt. Require all these fields unchanged around the force and no live predictor histories. Completed physical steps remain0 even though Nstep carries a nonzero imported source label. Record source signed dterror separately from audit-local FixedDt error;never call GetDt or DtVariable to manufacture telemetry.
actual_force_and_restoration: Exactly one real Interaction_Forces(SymPredictor) per saved endpoint. Download actual corrected C,completed Ace,endpoint theta and complete rate before PosInteraction_Forces frees temporary force arrays. Require all native source positions/velocity/double stress/p/p0/J/plastic/passive rho/load bits unchanged. Saved theta/FSType/FSNormal intentionally differ from endpoint diagnostics;restore those native fields,pre-force PosDiv/rate and local stage/cache,then require the complete saved33 fields byte-exact by native ID/material coordinate. C is conditional endpoint diagnostic,not serialized source state. Force-stat maxima are first read only after a genuine force initialized them;no fake initial zero stats or old uninitialized maxima are read. All exceptions retain partial evidence and release live force scratch.

independent_rate.neighbors: Host all-slot O(N^2) search over the actual downloaded native+periodic fluid set,not production neighbor lists. d=double-position difference with y0,actual float support radius and eta2;use actual CPU Wendland header GetKernel_Fac(CSP,float(dot(d,d))) promoted double,and actual endpoint C_i/C_j. V_j=V0 J_j. Reference is explicitly conditioned on actual C,Ace and endpoint theta,not an independent proof of their construction or the original force stages.
independent_rate.formula: g_ij=gradW(d),gi=C_i g_ij,gj=C_j g_ij,w_ij=V_j d·(gi+gj)/(r^2+eta2). lp=sum w_ij(p_i-p_j),lx=sum w_ij d,Gp=-sum V_j(p_i-p_j)gi,GJ=sum V_j(J_j-J_i)gi,divAce=sum V_j(Ace_j-Ace_i)·gi. rate=B[-theta+k/gamma(lp-Gp·lx+rhow divAce)+(alpha k)/gamma GJ·(Gp+rhow Ace_i)],B=Kw/n,alpha=0 constant or1/((1-n0)Ck) variable. No explicit g is added to the complete Darcy rate:physical solid acceleration is Ace+g. Lstar is not represented as a conservative pair flux.
independent_rate.prior_budget: Original64FLT_EPS raw-majorant+256DBL_EPS max(1,|B theta|)+1e-6 Pa/s. The majorant propagates absolute lp pair terms,componentwise absolute Gp/lx terms,absolute divergence-Ace pair terms and absolute smooth-chain inputs through the same local B/k/gamma. No fitted tolerance,5Pa trajectory tolerance substituted for rate budget,or post-result rounding adjustment.
independent_rate.q: CSV conditional q=-k/gamma(Gp+rhow Ace) is derived from the conditional endpoint reference;it is not a native saved flux or direct face-flow measurement. No q-null/flux-conservation gate or wall assertion is made.

gradient_and_step: Independently compute endpoint uk=B/gamma alpha k |GJ|;actual last-force DynamicConductivitySpeedMax must match maximum native reference under original64FLT_EPS max(1,reference). Only after actual force has initialized VelMax/AceMax/ViscDtMax,call GetDynamicStepScalesGpu and independently recompute current-J maximum cu^2/current-k diffusion with the original strict RH margin64DBL_EPS max(rho,rhow). Require actual wave/pore relative agreement64DBL_EPS and locked dt plus DtMin within minimum of original CFL/acceleration/wave,pore and safety*h/uk necessary bounds. No sufficient stability or every original force-stage claim.
predeclared_wrong_g: For every native CSV row record counterfactual erroneous explicit +g and -g rate additions. The analytic delta is +/- B/gamma alpha*k*rhow*(GJ dot g). For variable full257 audit require at least one postinitial native point with |delta|>100 original same-point rate budgets. Both signs have that identical absolute witness. Constant and smoke/t0 are exempt from nonempty signal only,not the correct-rate budget. These are formula counterfactuals,not altered Ace,wrong-kernel calls or deliberately faulty solver trajectories. Empty signal rejects unchanged;do not relax or tune it.
outputs: Run.out and normal fresh initialization diagnostics

counts.periodic_ghost_checks: Actual sum across every imported endpoint,nonzero;not guessed from a fixed image count.

external_evidence_required: The later owned wrapper must bind current source/build/helper/tool/runtime/program,exact runtime+BI4 and every original saved raw file before/after,plus typed owned exit and Debug actual memcheck0errors/0leaks. This C++ source does not implement SHA/CNG,verify external source bytes or prove solver ownership. Do not claim raw hashes verified merely because files are opened read-only. Completed data is never rerun for an offline audit failure.
not_proved: Original internal predictor/corrector force-stage rates,C,Ace or cache;actual native q,water balance,hydrostatic/static equilibrium,wall gravity,arbitrary k-field/interface consistency,public GPU gravity,continuum/full-cycle/physical accuracy or CPU/GPU integrator identity.
